findings.title: Non-deterministic e2e journey: 'shell: navigation, language persistence and My Work' presses Tab before the shell has mounted after page.reload(), so the skip-link toBeFocused assertion intermittently fails (1 of 29 normal runs; 1 of 15 under CPU load) and, because the spec is serial, skips the remaining 7 journeys of that locale
findings.reproduction: Disposable clone of candidate sha256:e6979e12… (commit 485e91f), Node v22.22.2, PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=/opt/pw-browsers. (1) E2E_PG_PORT=55941 apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh npx playwright test apps/web/e2e --workers=1 --reporter=list -> 1 failed, 7 did not run, 10 passed, exit 1 ([chromium-en] journeys.spec.ts:156, line 172: expect(getByRole('link', {name: 'Skip to main content'})).toBeFocused() -> Received: inactive, 9x over 5000 ms). (2) With three parallel `pnpm test` runs as CPU load on the 4-CPU host: apps/web/e2e/support/with-stack.sh npx playwright test apps/web/e2e/journeys.spec.ts -g 'shell: navigation' --project=chromium-en --repeat-each=15 --workers=1 -> 1 failed / 14 passed, same assertion. Without load: two more full suite runs 18/18, the qa-stack run 22/22, and --repeat-each=10 over both locales 20/20. Root cause (test synchronisation, not a product defect): after `await page.reload()` the test only waits for `html[lang]`, but `public/locale-boot.js` sets <html lang dir> before first paint, i.e. before React has mounted the shell. The Tab keypress can therefore land while no focusable element exists; in the failure snapshot the skip link (first focusable element) is present afterwards but unfocused (screenshot shows the fully rendered My Work page with nothing focused).
findings.expected: A required gate check (master prompt §0: required checks run and pass; playwright.config.ts retries: 0, so CI is red on any flake) that is deterministic: after the reload, wait for a post-mount signal (e.g. the primary navigation or the My Work heading to be visible) before pressing Tab, as the earlier part of the same test already does after sign-in.
findings.actual: Intermittent failure of the required e2e journeys check (first run of this review: exit 1, 7 EN journeys not executed). The product behaviour itself is correct in every run where the shell had mounted (skip link is the first focusable element; 28 of 29 unloaded runs and 14 of 15 loaded runs pass).
